output.title: Member callback scheduling hours
output.draft_text:
Q: What hours can we schedule a callback?

A: Schedule member callbacks on weekdays between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern. (Source: approved unit U-KNOWN-FACT.)

If the member is outside the Eastern time zone, convert the requested time to Eastern before scheduling so it falls within the window.

Holidays: [whether callbacks can be scheduled on company holidays, and which holidays apply].

If the member asks for a callback outside these hours: [what the advocate should offer or do instead].

Latest available start time for a callback: [latest slot that can be booked before 6:00 p.m. Eastern].
